description: Source file implementing Linux network interface statistics retrieval via Netlink sockets, including functions to get interface stats, accumulate VLAN stats, and gather data for access points and endpoints in a wireless radio context.

methods.name: s_getRtmNewLinkInterfaceStats
methods.description: Parses a Netlink message to extract interface statistics for a specific network interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getInterfaceStats
methods.description: Retrieves network interface statistics via Netlink socket for a given interface name.

methods.name: s_getUpperIface
methods.description: Checks if interface name starts with 'upper_' and returns the base interface name.

methods.name: s_filterUpperVlans
methods.description: Filters directory entries to identify VLAN interfaces based on sysfs entries.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_acculumateUpperVlansStats
methods.description: Accumulates statistics for upper VLAN interfaces associated with a main interface.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getVapStats
methods.description: Gets statistics for a virtual access point interface and its WDS interfaces.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllVapStats
methods.description: Aggregates statistics for all VAPs associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getAllEpStats
methods.description: Aggregates statistics for all endpoints associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_linuxIfStats_getRadioStats
methods.description: Retrieves combined radio statistics including VAPs, endpoints, and noise level.
